settings.title: Installing Your Drapes
How to Install Adjustable Hooks for Pleated Drapes

settings.text:
1. Set the pin hooks to your preferred height.
  2. Push each pin hook into the header tape (inside the seam) until fully secure.
  3. Hook the pins into the eyelets of the curtain rings.

settings.title: How to Install Grommet Curtains

settings.text:
1. Slide the curtain rod directly through the grommets.
  2. Neatly shape the grommet folds along the top of the panel.

settings.title: How to Install Rod Pocket Curtains

settings.text:
1. Slide the curtain rod through the pre-sewn pocket at the top of the curtain.
  2. Neatly shape the fabric along the top pocket so the panel hangs evenly.

settings.title: How to Adjust the Side Hem

settings.text:
1. Fold the side hem inward, if desired.
  2. Tuck it behind the nearest hook.

settings.title: Measuring Your Shades
How to Measure Outside Mount Shades & Blinds

settings.text:
1. Measure the width outside your window frame.
    Add your desired overlap on both sides
    (1–2 inches recommended).
  2. Measure the full outside frame height.
    Add the height you want above the frame
    (4–6 inches recommended).

Use our Measurement Tool to confirm your final sizes.

settings.title: How to Measure Inside Mount Shades & Blinds

settings.text:
1. Check the window depth at the top of the frame.
  2. Measure the window width at the top, middle, and bottom
    Use the smallest measurement and subtract 3/8 inch for the final order width.
  3. Measure the window height on the left, center, and right
    Use the largest measurement for the final order height.

Use our Measurement Tool to confirm your final sizes.

settings.title: Installing Your Shades
How to Install Outside Mount Cordless Roman Shades

settings.text:
1. Mark the mounting positions and drill holes.
  2. Attach the outer bracket and spacer with the bolt and nut.
  3. Screw the assembled brackets into place.
  4. Clip the headrail onto the brackets.

settings.title: How to Install Inside Mount Cordless Roman Shades
How to Control Motorized Roman Shades With the Speaker

settings.text:
1. Add your smart speaker to the Apple Home app.
  2. Press the motor pairing button (four short beeps + one long) to add the motor to Apple Home.

settings.title: How to Install Inside Mount Cordless Woven Shades

settings.text:
1. Mark the bracket positions and drill pilot holes.
  2. Screw the mounting brackets into place.
  3. Clip the headrail onto the brackets and tighten the wing nuts.

settings.title: How to Install Outside Mount Woven Shades

settings.text:
1. Mark the bracket positions above the frame and drill the mounting holes.
  2. Screw the mounting brackets firmly into place.
  3. Clip the headrail onto the brackets and tighten the wing nuts to secure.

settings.title: How to Install No Drill Handwoven Shade

settings.text:
1. Use the inner bracket to locate drill points and drill pilot holes.
  2. Secure the inner brackets, attach the outer brackets, and tighten the bolts.
  3. Place the shade inside the frame and fully tighten the nuts.
